what: Empty-content delete semantics are not bit-for-bit compatible with plan-block-write.sh
scenario_or_breakage: Today an empty content file still produces a canonical empty larch:plan block and MODE=replaced or MODE=appended; the proposed named-block-write.sh removes an existing block and emits MODE=removed, so plan-block-write.sh --content-file /dev/null would silently delete the plan
suggested_fix: Make deletion an explicit flag or opt-in mode used only by design-pause callers; keep --marker plan wrapper preserving empty-block replace/append and add regression cases to scripts/test-plan-block.sh

what: Marker parameterization lacks a validation or escaping contract
scenario_or_breakage: Current regex constants are safe because plan is literal; a generic --marker NAME interpolated into grep -E can make regex metacharacters match or replace the wrong marker family
suggested_fix: Specify and test either a fixed marker registry {plan,design-pause} or strict NAME validation plus ERE escaping before constructing MARK_START and MARK_END

what: Plan relies on inherited gh retry behavior that does not exist
scenario_or_breakage: The current writer performs one gh issue view and one gh issue edit; extracting it as-is will not handle transient rate limits despite the pause edge case claiming retry coverage
suggested_fix: Add explicit bounded retry/backoff to named-block-write.sh if pause requires it, or revise the edge-case/failure-mode text and tests to reflect single-shot behavior

what: The new gh body writer is not added to the path-triggered body-file rule
scenario_or_breakage: .named-block-write.sh will become the shared gh issue edit --body-file implementation, but future edits to it will not trigger the repository rule that enforces body-file and redaction practices
suggested_fix: Add scripts/named-block-write.sh and scripts/named-block-write.md to .claude/rules/gh-body-file.md frontmatter

what: New pause/resume harness is promised but Makefile is not in the modification list
scenario_or_breakage: CI will not run skills/design/scripts/test-design-pause-resume.sh unless Makefile gains a target and shard wiring
suggested_fix: Add UPDATED: Makefile to the plan and register test-design-pause-resume in the appropriate harness shard
